body.x: FALCON (CEO, Park Dong Kwon) participated in the ‘CES 2017’ held in Las Vegas, the United States from January 5th to January 8th as Daegu Common Facility of the Mobile Convergence Center of Daegu Technopark and exhibited ‘Outdoor Smart TV.’

‘Outdoor Smart TV’ is possible to receive 170 satellite broadcasting and terrestrial broadcasting from all around the world. This is a plug-in play TV for consumers who are not professional can install this system by themselves and use it. Also, they can watch it in desert, mountainous areas, and large vehicles and during urgent disaster broadcast.

Moreover, this is used as Internet, Hot Spot, YouTube, and more when it is connected to communications network. Also, it supports languages of 70 countries all over the world, so this can be used in many different countries.

The CEO of FALCON, Park Dong Kwon, said, “Our product received a lot of attentions from buyers, so I confirmed the possibility of the product in the American market. I plan to enter the market with a complete one.”

Meanwhile, the Daegu Technopark and Smart Venture Institute and Smart Drone Technology Center of Kyungpook National University opened ‘CES Daegu Common Facility’ and supported the exhibition operation of 22 domestic enterprises and business meeting with a buyer.

CES (Consumer Technology Show), which is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow, is a good opportunity to figure out the flow of the global electronic industry at a glance and is held on every January by CTA (Consumer Technology Association).

Aving News Korea, which have reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA as the world’ three major technology exhibitions the most for the last 10 years, will send a special group of reporters to CES, report main issues of the markets, and introduce Korean enterprises all over the world this year.
